title: Express session discovery and report test intent through page objects

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — SEED-300#express-session-test-intent-through-page-objects at 806a3bfb42f8949f03e9220385b0871a0ae8cc47

Verdict: Caught.

Promise checked (Key example 1, Delete record… branch): a compact Session entry's Delete record… asks in place with the keyboard on Keep; Keep (or Escape) ends the asking, puts the keyboard back on the button, and deletes nothing. The caller's suggested promise and fault held against the revision and were used unchanged except for locating the fault in the shared owner of the question.

Fault: dashboard/src/AskInPlace.tsx, InPlaceQuestion's keeping button — `onClick={asking.keepAsIs}` changed to `onClick={(event) => { asking.confirm(event.currentTarget); }}`, so pressing Keep confirms the action (here, deletes the record) instead of cancelling. Escape handling, fixtures and all assertions were left intact. (AskInPlace is shared by Delete record… and Mark as done; only the delete spec was run.)

Maintained check examined: dashboard/tests/sessions/agent-launch-story-card-delete.spec.ts, test "Delete record… on a State unknown entry asks first, Keep and Escape delete nothing, and confirming removes the entry everywhere and moves the keyboard", step "Keep restores the button with the keyboard on it and deletes nothing" (opens the question via askToDeleteRecord / deleteRecordQuestion from dashboard/tests/support/sessionEntryDisclosure.ts).

Assertion that caught it: line 117, `await expect(await deleteButton(execution)).toBeFocused()` — failed with "element(s) not found" after `asked.keep.click()`, because the Execution entry had left Story B's card. The later `expect(stored()).toContain(kept)` (line 119) was not reached; the catch is the focus-on-restored-button assertion. The test's other two cases (Session unavailable confirm; Working/Needs input offers none) passed under the fault, as expected since they do not press Keep. Claim limited to the Keep-click path on a State unknown story-card entry.

Run observations:
- Scratch checkout: `git worktree add --detach .../tmp/coverage-wt 806a3bfb4`, `npm ci --silent`; pre-probe `git status --porcelain` empty.
- Baseline (unfaulted): focused command `env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- dashboard/tests/sessions/agent-launch-story-card-delete.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=list` → 3 passed (21.7s); the Keep step ran.
- Reach and independent wrong-behavior witness: a temporary untracked scratch spec (dashboard/tests/sessions/zz-intent-keep-witness.spec.ts, same story-columns journey and MakeMe-free journey setup as the maintained case) asked Delete record… on the State unknown Execution entry, pressed Keep, waited for the question to resolve, then read the launch store file and the entry count. Unfaulted: "entries=1 record stored=true". Faulted: "entries=0 record stored=false" — Keep deleted the record and removed the entry.
- Faulted maintained run: 1 failed, 2 passed (17.1s), failure at line 117 in the Keep step as above.
- Restoration: a shell trap copied the saved original back; `cmp` against the saved copy matched and `git diff` was empty; the witness rerun on restored code showed "entries=1 record stored=true" (passed, 14.5s); the witness file was deleted; `git status --porcelain` empty again; maintained spec rerun → 3 passed (19.6s). Scratch worktree removed with `git worktree remove --force`.
- Machine load (uptime 1/5/15-min): start 7.85/17.62/29.79; around runs 10.2–16.9 (1-min).

Next proof action: none required for this promise; the maintained Keep step catches a Keep-confirms fault. Optional strengthening is not indicated by this evidence.

Prior disposition: none matched; no new repair decision arises from this probe. Test repair and follow-up routing remain with the caller.

Costs:
- Test runtime: measured, Playwright-reported wall time per run — maintained spec baseline 21.7 s, faulted 17.1 s, restored 19.6 s; scratch witness unfaulted 6.0 s, faulted 6.3 s, restored 14.5 s; total ≈ 85.2 s across six runs (excludes npm ci).
- Human effort: unavailable — no human interaction occurred during the probe and no separate measure exists.
- Agent effort: unavailable — no separately supported token or tool-time measure is exposed to this agent; the elapsed entry below covers the agent's whole interval.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 205028 ms (measured), from 1794552593111 to 1794552798139 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision: 806a3bfb42f8949f03e9220385b0871a0ae8cc47. Evidence: the maintained Keep step in agent-launch-story-card-delete.spec.ts failed under a Keep-confirms fault and passed after verified restoration, with an independent witness showing the record deleted. Decision: no follow-up; the probe found no gap and no delivered defect. This one probe covers only the Keep-click path of Key example 1. Canonical follow-up links: none.
